parse_hf_uri: parse a Hugging Face Hub URI string into an HfUri dataclass with type, id, revision, and path
parse_hf_mount: parse a HF mount specification string into an HfMount with source URI, mount path, and read-only flag
is_hf_uri: test whether a string is a valid hf:// URI without raising exceptions
create_HfUri: create an HfUri dataclass representing a parsed Hugging Face Hub resource location
create_HfMount: create an HfMount dataclass pairing an HfUri source with a local mount path and optional read-only flag
